title: Derived transport with cartesian stage interfaces
statement: For the two cartesian squares and a compatible map r of their source overlaps and m of their cartesian pullbacks, construct the fixed derived transport as a natural isomorphism from derived pullback along r followed by the g-stage functor to the f-stage functor followed by derived pullback along m. The forward stage functors are exactly pullback along the inverse cartesian isomorphisms, so the data are the existing constructed derived transport with those two endpoint functors rewritten by their proved equations.

source.place: Restriction compatibility; fixed derived-pullback composition in Tag 0D5S.

proof.text: Rewrite the two endpoint stage functors using perfectOverlapStageEquivalence_functor_eq and apply the existing constructed perfectOverlapDerivedPullbackTransport. This is the canonical source construction; it is definitionally equal to the former direct transport.

proof_origin.place: Retire the Sheaf twin in favour of the unchanged canonical source construction; preserve all dependencies and the unit route.

lean.statement: def perfectOverlapStageTransport {X Y K C T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (f : K ⟶ Y) (pX : X ⟶ C) (pK : K ⟶ T) (pY : Y ⟶ S) (b : C ⟶ S) (q : T ⟶ S) (hg : IsPullback g pX pY b) (hf : IsPullback f pK pY q) (U V : Y.Opens) (r : (g ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V)).toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V)).toScheme) (m : pullback ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ pY) b ⟶ pullback ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ pY) q) (hmap : ((isPullback_morphismRestrict g (U ⊓ V)).paste_vert hg).isoPullback.inv ≫ r = m ≫ ((isPullback_morphismRestrict f (U ⊓ V)).paste_vert hf).isoPullback.inv) : derivedPullback r ⋙ (perfectOverlapStageEquivalence g pX pY b hg U V).functor ≅ (perfectOverlapStageEquivalence f pK pY q hf U V).functor ⋙ derivedPullback m
